structured_output.what_is_happening: A pump.fun-launched Solana token named "BSCNews" (ticker BSCNews) migrated to PumpSwap ~74 minutes before detection and already ran +150-162% in the hour before the trigger (dexscreener h1 price_change +152%, geckoterminal +151.44%), then began reversing hard: m5 change -18.73% (dex) / -3.2% (gecko), h6 change -28% to -29%, and price is already ~36-52% below its all-time-high (ATH 7.449e-05 vs trigger price 4.763e-05). Volume is large relative to market cap ($185k h6 vol vs $34.5k mcap) but wallet composition is heavily bot/bundle-driven: 195 bundler wallets and 38 sniper wallets out of 244 total GMGN-tracked holders, a 61.3% bot/degen rate, and a buys-per-unique-buyer ratio of 2.67 flagged by the packet as churn. The project's X account (BenX_HQ) has a rename history showing it was previously "kcryptoinvest" (2021), a recycled-account red flag, and the token's own description states fees route "via @UsePaid," consistent with a creator-monetization/token-factory scheme rather than an organic community project. The creator address has launched 5,384 tokens total. Four other same-name "BSCNews" clone tokens exist, all essentially dead ($0-3.4k liquidity), and one of them predates this contract by ~2.5 minutes, so this is the token that caught bundled/bot traction first, not necessarily a literally-first deploy.
